product_overview: Shesheny Motors is a luxury car dealership website where guests can browse inventory, view vehicle details, save favorites, submit contact or custom requests, and manage deposit-related actions. An authenticated admin can log in to manage vehicles and related site content.
core_goals: Browse the vehicle inventory and discover featured cars
Filter, search, and open detailed vehicle pages
Save vehicles to favorites and manage a deposit cart
Submit contact inquiries and custom vehicle requests
Authenticate as an admin and manage vehicles and site data

features.name: Public site navigation and vehicle discovery
features.description: Visitors can open the main public pages, browse inventory, and view featured or detailed vehicle information.
user_flows: Navigate to /index.html -> Observe the homepage hero and featured vehicles -> Open the inventory page -> Browse the vehicle listings -> Select a vehicle -> View the vehicle details page
Navigate to /inventory.html -> Filter inventory by make or model -> Review the updated listing results -> Select a vehicle -> View specifications on the details page

features.name: Favorites management
features.description: Visitors can save vehicles they like and review or remove them later from the favorites page.
user_flows: Navigate to /inventory.html -> Select a vehicle -> Open the vehicle details page -> Add the vehicle to favorites -> Navigate to /favorites.html -> See the saved vehicle listed
Navigate to /favorites.html -> Review saved vehicles -> Remove a vehicle from favorites -> See the vehicle disappear from the favorites list

features.name: Deposit cart flow
features.description: Visitors can add a vehicle for deposit and submit a deposit request from the cart.
user_flows: Navigate to /inventory.html -> Select a vehicle -> Open the vehicle details page -> Add the vehicle to the deposit cart -> Navigate to /cart.html -> Review the selected vehicle -> Submit the deposit request form -> See the cart submission confirmation

features.name: Contact and custom request forms
features.description: Visitors can send a general inquiry through the contact page and submit a specialized vehicle request through the request form.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact.html -> Fill in the contact form fields -> Submit the form -> See the inquiry confirmation
Navigate to /request.html -> Fill in budget and requirement details -> Submit the form -> See the request confirmation

features.name: Admin authentication and dashboard access
features.description: An administrator can sign in to access the protected dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /login.html -> Fill in email input field -> Fill in password input field -> Click Login button to submit -> See the admin dashboard

features.name: Vehicle management in admin dashboard
features.description: An authenticated administrator can create, update, and delete vehicle records from the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin.html -> View list of vehicles -> Add new vehicle -> Fill in vehicle details -> Save the new vehicle -> See the vehicle appear in the list
Navigate to /admin.html -> View list of vehicles -> Select an existing vehicle -> Edit existing vehicle -> Update vehicle details -> Save changes -> See the updated vehicle information
Navigate to /admin.html -> View list of vehicles -> Select an existing vehicle -> Delete vehicle -> Confirm the removal -> See the vehicle removed from the list

features.name: Admin site management settings
features.description: An authenticated administrator can manage site translation content and other site settings from the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin.html -> Manage site translations -> Update translation content -> Save the changes -> See the updated translation settings

features.name: Admin Features
features.description: Manage vehicles, users, and site settings

features.name: Client UI - Inventory Browsing
user_interactions: Click on a vehicle to view details

features.name: Client UI - Forms
features.description: Submit contact and custom request forms
